summary: Frontend E2E verification of FloraSetu Phase 6 Ops Control Tower + discipline-isolated Ops workspaces (ADR-013). Executed via the public preview URL against the live NestJS backend. All Phase 6 owner rulings verified GREEN for demo.procops and demo.finance. One BLOCKER discovered: demo.support user has empty org memberships and cannot enter the Ops workspace at all — the support-side READ-ONLY claims path could not be exercised because /api/auth/me returns memberships:[] and WorkspaceGuard shows 'You don't have access to Operations'.

OpsOrdersPage.tsx correctly renders a monitor-only SideSheet with the 'Domain actions stay with the responsible party' note and no fulfilment buttons.

OpsClaimDetailPage.tsx gates the ops-claim-decision-panel behind explicit permission and renders ops-claim-readonly-note otherwise — verified structurally.

SEED DATA / BACKEND: demo.support@florasetu.dev returns memberships:[] on /api/auth/me despite being a documented Phase 6 test credential. Add a SUPPORT_AGENT membership on the FloraSetu Platform org for this user.

rca_of_the_issue: Support user authenticates successfully (POST /api/auth/login → 201 with accessToken) but the subsequent GET /api/auth/me returns memberships:[]. Because WorkspaceGuard requires an active org membership matching workspace='ops', the ops shell never mounts for this user. Root cause is missing seed data (no SUPPORT_AGENT membership row for this user on the FloraSetu Platform org). Mitigation: extend the demo/seed script to insert a SUPPORT_AGENT membership on the platform org for demo.support@florasetu.dev; no frontend code change required.
